# ABOUT

James Cook is a design leader and mentor based in Bristol, UK.
20+ years' experience delivering software systems, defining design practices, and developing people. He helps organisations build great in‑house teams and digital services.
He's worked internationally with a wide range of clients across sectors, including Thoughtworks, OVO Energy, Selfridges, Springer Nature, Singapore Government, Student Loans Company, BBC, and Amnesty International.

Synthetic audio introduction: https://www.hellojames.co.uk/media/James-Cook-summary.mp3
Professional Summary: https://www.hellojames.co.uk/media/James-Cook-summary.pdf
Available for design mentoring: https://www.adplist.org/mentors/james-cook/
Connect professionally: https://www.linkedin.com/in/hellojames/

# WRITING

Getting better feedback on your work
https://www.hellojames.co.uk/writing/better-feedback/
A simple, practical framework for structuring feedback requests by progress stage.

Design by autocomplete
https://www.hellojames.co.uk/writing/design-autocomplete/
A talk examining how much of the design process we should want to automate with generative AI.

What the Ancient Egyptians teach us about iteration
https://www.hellojames.co.uk/writing/egyptian-iteration/
A piece making the case for continuous, iterative software development over upfront definition.

What iteration looks like
https://www.hellojames.co.uk/writing/look-iteration/
A demonstration of real iterative software evolution over multiple months.

Continuous design & development
https://www.hellojames.co.uk/writing/continuous-design/
A talk exploring why rigid upfront planning often fails and how lightweight, iterative practices lead to better outcomes.
